ADMIN.label: Administrator
ADMIN.description: Full control of the platform. Created by another admin, or by the seed script for the very first one.

STAFF.label: Staff
STAFF.description: Internal team member. Can only do what the permissions assigned by an admin allow.

B2B.label: B2B partner
B2B.description: Travel agency or business partner. Registers itself, then waits for admin approval before operational access.

B2C.label: Customer
B2C.description: Individual traveller. Registers itself or signs in with Firebase.

permissions.USER_MANAGE: Create, suspend and change user accounts
permissions.VISA_UPDATE: Change the status of visa applications
permissions.TOUR_MANAGE: Manage tour packages and custom tours
permissions.MEMBERSHIP_MANAGE: Manage membership plans, sell and change memberships, and read membership reports
